reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 9 points better, in a game of about 221 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pacers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 75 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 195 and 244 total points.
